title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1983-08-30
lineage: Master Cassettes (Technics RS-B48R, dbx decoded) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes;  3 x Nakamichi 700 mics (left and right cardioid, center omni, row R, seat 208, DFC) > Jamie Pouris' custom mixer/NX40 dbx encoder > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Well‑played show captured with clear matrix‑style sound quality.
ai_review.review: The reviewers praised the band's tight playing, noting that ‘the boys were on it,’ and highlighted the excellent audio fidelity, describing the tape as sounding like a matrix. The Severson source delivers a clean, balanced mix, making this recording both musically satisfying and technically enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong performance and great sound quality; with only one opinion the rating reflects a solid but not exceptional consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix typical of Severson matrix tapes; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer notes the band was tight and energetic but gives no specific comments on song order or pacing.
